title: gate add --kind provisional says at once when the gate's class makes it the operator's
goal: Answers the SP-vmxdxtru retrospective: ST-rbcr2tm6's worker recorded a provisional gate, which gate add made blocking and of class push because the item's touches name _tools/kg_; the worker could not answer it, implemented its recommendation and the item waited for the operator. gate add --kind provisional on a gate whose class is in bl_authority.OPERATOR_CLASSES prints that the gate is blocking and the operator's, with the class and why, so the worker stops and reports; the kb-worker agent and the runbook say what a worker does then.
